news.title: Anthropic's Model Context Protocol crossed 97 million installs in March 2026
news.snippet: Anthropic's Model Context Protocol crossed 97 million installs in March 2026, a milestone that signals its transition from an experimental standard to foundational infrastructure for building AI agents.

tech.title: How to Use AI in 2026: The Complete Proficiency Guide
tech.snippet: Both agree on one thing: tell the AI what to do, not what not to do. Instead of 'Don't use jargon,' try 'Explain in plain language a non-technical reader would understand.' Positive instructions consistently outperform negative ones.
